OpenDuet reads your calendar to prepare meeting briefs and uses it to create or change events you request, following your app boundaries.
OpenDuet reads and updates events on this Mac when you request calendar work.
OpenDuet reads, creates and updates reminders you request, following your app boundaries.
OpenDuet helps with your reminders on this Mac when you request it.
OpenDuet searches contacts on this Mac to resolve exact people and addresses for your requests.
When you talk to OpenDuet, it listens through the microphone. Your voice is turned into text on this Mac and never sent anywhere.
OpenDuet turns what you say into text on this Mac, with on-device recognition only. Nothing is sent to Apple or anyone else.
OpenDuet uses Mail, Messages and Music on this Mac for your requests, following your allow, ask or never rules.
